findings.current: I’m not answering because the thing asking isn’t a person.
findings.defect: The Korean calls the speaker a “새끼,” a blunt insult. “The thing” preserves the dehumanizing sense but drops the explicit profanity and weakens the line’s register.
findings.rationale: The source uses the profane noun “새끼” for the one asking; the surrounding exchange also maintains blunt, profane hostility.
findings.replacement: I’m not answering because some bastard who isn’t even human is asking.

summary: One minor register shift softens the insult in the dialogue.
